name: The Coroner Saga
source:
Sara is a young doctor who just completed Med School with the highest degrees. Uncertain about her future she joins the Coroners' State Institute and the adventure begins!

[From [url=https://www.thecoronersaga.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
Sara是一名刚以优异成绩从医学院毕业的年轻医生。她对未来感到迷茫，于是加入州验尸官研究所，冒险就此开始！

[来源：[url=https://www.thecoronersaga.com/]官方网站[/url]]
